summary: Iter-11 logo integration verified end-to-end. 9/9 backend pytest cases pass (test_v11_logo.py): logo asset reachability (white+gold both 200, >100KB), email_service render_order_confirmation embeds white logo URL twice (header+footer) with alt='Rimpods', index.html meta tags correct (og:image+twitter:image=gold qiztl9hf, favicon+apple-touch-icon=white 5gz4ojsf, og:title contains 'Tank yang hidup, bukan sekadar indah'), and regression endpoints (GET /api/products, POST /api/orders, /payment/midtrans/snap-token, /payment/midtrans/notification) all reachable. Frontend Playwright check confirms header brand-logo and footer logo both render with naturalWidth=4000 (real image load, not 404), correct src+alt, cart add+UpsellModal regression flow alive. Admin dashboard logo verified by code review (same URL pattern, identical img element shape as Header/Landing).
critical_code_review_comments: Logo URL is duplicated in 4 places (Header.jsx LOGO_URL const, Landing.jsx footer inline, AdminDashboard.jsx inline, email_service._LOGO_URL, plus 2 spots in index.html). Consider centralizing to a single config (e.g., src/lib/brand.js exporting LOGO_WHITE_URL / LOGO_GOLD_URL) so future asset rotation is a 1-line change. Currently a future logo update requires touching 5 files.

index.html: og:image and twitter:image both use the gold logo on transparent PNG — when scrapers render OG previews against light backgrounds (e.g., iMessage), gold-on-transparent may have low contrast. Consider a solid-bg OG card variant for social previews if engagement data shows preview clicks lagging.

AdminDashboard.jsx header logo img has no data-testid (line 153-157). Header.jsx wraps logo in a Link with data-testid='brand-logo' but admin dashboard logo is bare. Adding data-testid='admin-brand-logo' would help future regression tests. Non-blocking.

Frontend logo files are 105KB (white) and 135KB (gold) — these are the original 4000x?? PNGs without resize. The Header renders at h-11 (44px) so the browser is downscaling a 4000px image. Recommend serving a 256px-wide pre-resized variant to cut LCP by ~200-300ms on 4G.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (header logo + footer logo + meta tags + cart regression + upsell modal — all PASS)

test_credentials: Used existing test_credentials.md guidance — admin OAuth not exercised in this iter-11 since logo addition does not touch auth flow. Iter-10 already validated rimpods@gmail.com whitelist E2E.
seed_data_creation: 1 test order with contact.notes='TEST_iter11' created via POST /api/orders during regression test, then deleted via mongosh (deletedCount=2 — earlier orphan from initial failing run was also cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-11 added logo assets only (no behavior change). White logo (5gz4ojsf) used for header/footer/email/favicon/admin. Gold logo (qiztl9hf) used for og:image+twitter:image. Both URLs are external CDN (customer-assets.emergentagent.com) — verified 200 OK with image/* content-type. test_v11_logo.py uses correct product_id 'rotifer-2l-phyto' (NOT 'starter' — that was iter1 stub no longer in seeded products). Current valid product IDs: rotifer-2l-phyto, paket-hemat-5r-1p, tbn-turn-back-nutrients. Cart add → upsell modal trigger flow confirmed working in browser automation.
rca of the issue: N/A — single test failure (test_create_order with stale product_id 'starter') was a test-script issue, not a backend bug. Fixed by using current seeded product_id.
